name: local-llm
description: Opt-in access to the locally-served Qwen 3.8 27B model (LM Studio Splash, 4-bit). Bundles the `local-qwen` delegation subagent and the `local-llm` reference skill. Deliberately NOT installed into ~/.claude — it is loaded per-session via `claude subagent` so a plain `claude` never sees it.
